description: This file defines mock classes for testing the LifecycleManager, LifecycleManagerState, and related interfaces in a C++ project. It uses Google Mock to provide mock implementations for methods in these interfaces, facilitating unit testing.

classes.name: LifecycleManagerMock
classes.description: Mock implementation of the ILifecycleManager interface for testing purposes.

classes.name: LifecycleManagerNotificationMock
classes.description: Mock implementation of the ILifecycleManager::INotification interface.

classes.name: LifecycleManagerStateMock
classes.description: Mock implementation of the ILifecycleManagerState interface for testing purposes.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Mocks the registration of a notification for the LifecycleManager.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Mocks the unregistration of a notification for the LifecycleManager.

methods.name: GetLoadedApps
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the list of loaded applications.

methods.name: IsAppLoaded
methods.description: Mocks checking if an application is loaded based on appId.

methods.name: SetTargetAppState
methods.description: Mocks setting the target state of an app instance.

methods.name: SendIntentToActiveApp
methods.description: Mocks sending an intent to the currently active app.
